name: local-audit
comment: Every script cds to the repo root first: the .mjs files resolve docs/reference-screenshots/... relative to process.cwd(), while node resolves node_modules from the script's own directory. `npm run audit` is the correct full order -- measure-reference is deliberately NOT part of it (it hits the live reference site; re-run it only when the reference itself may have changed).

scripts.check: cd ../.. && node tools/local-audit/check-colors.mjs && node tools/local-audit/check-metrics.mjs && node tools/local-audit/check-section-position.mjs && node tools/local-audit/check-overflow.mjs
scripts.audit: npm run capture && npm run crop && npm run diff:header && npm run diff:footer && npm run check
